title: Weekend Plan Checklist from ChatGPT
model_settings: Default ChatGPT web chat; Instant mode button visible in the composer. Exact backend model name was not exposed in the UI.

artifact_versions.notes: Initial one-file weekend packing and errand checklist. Rendered and generated a list, but duplicated related items and produced a long 50+ item checklist.
Added deduping and Essentials/Nice-to-have split. Rendered, but sample output was still long.
Added filters and a next-five summary. Rendered and generated a checklist.
Added timing groups: Before leaving, On the way, At arrival, Sunday reset. Rendered and generated a checklist.
Attempted cleaner row controls and mobile/print/export polish, but verification found ReferenceError: nextFiveItems is not defined.
Bug-fix prompt restored nextFiveItems while keeping cleaner row controls. Verified with sample generation.

verification_notes: Verified final fixed artifact over local HTTP: page renders, sample plan loads, Generate checklist creates 47 checkbox items, Next 5 summary appears, timing groups appear, filters/export/print controls are visible, and the missing nextFiveItems bug from step 5 is fixed in the step 6 artifact.

steps.prompt_exact: Make me a polished one-file browser tool that turns a messy weekend plan into a clean packing and errand checklist.
steps.response_exact: ChatGPT created a one-file HTML artifact named weekend_plan_checklist.html. The exact response and code are preserved in the source session link; the captured code for this version is saved at public/artifacts/weekend-plan-checklist-chatgpt-step-1.html.
steps.response_summary: Initial polished weekend checklist generator with local storage, export, print, trip type/weather/travel selectors, chips, and editable generated checklist.
steps.notes: Observation: worked visually, but sample output duplicated related items and generated a very long checklist.

steps.prompt_exact: The generated checklist works, but it repeats things like gift/card and formal outfit and can balloon into 50+ items. Add smarter deduping and split the output into Essentials first and Nice-to-have, while keeping it one self-contained HTML file.
steps.response_exact: ChatGPT updated the one-file HTML artifact and stated it would tighten item matching, collapse overlapping triggers, and add Essentials/Nice-to-have sections. The exact response and code are preserved in the source session link; the captured code for this version is saved at public/artifacts/weekend-plan-checklist-chatgpt-step-2.html.
steps.response_summary: Added deduping and split generated items into Essentials and Nice-to-have.
steps.notes: Observation: split helped, but the list was still long and needed focus controls.

steps.prompt_exact: This is cleaner, but the generated list is still long and there is no quick way to focus. Add simple filters for All, Essentials, Nice-to-have, and Done, plus a small “next 5 things to do” summary at the top of the checklist.
steps.response_exact: ChatGPT updated the one-file HTML artifact with filtering and a next-five summary. The exact response and code are preserved in the source session link; the captured code for this version is saved at public/artifacts/weekend-plan-checklist-chatgpt-step-3.html.
steps.response_summary: Added All/Essentials/Nice-to-have/Done filters and a next-five summary.
steps.notes: Observation: filters and next-five worked, but the list still needed timing context.

steps.prompt_exact: The filters help, but the list still feels like one giant pile. Add a time grouping so items can be marked as Before leaving, On the way, At arrival, or Sunday reset, and make the next-5 summary pull from the earliest unfinished group first.
steps.response_exact: ChatGPT updated the one-file HTML artifact with time grouping and earliest-group prioritization. The exact response and code are preserved in the source session link; the captured code for this version is saved at public/artifacts/weekend-plan-checklist-chatgpt-step-4.html.
steps.response_summary: Added timing groups and made next-five prioritize the earliest unfinished timing group.
steps.notes: Observation: timing worked, but row-level timing dropdowns made the checklist visually dense.

steps.prompt_exact: This is useful now, but the timing dropdown on every row makes the checklist feel dense. Make the row controls cleaner, improve the mobile layout, and make export/print include the timing groups and next-5 summary clearly.
steps.response_exact: ChatGPT updated the one-file HTML artifact and stated it would keep the same one-file HTML while cleaning up the interaction layer and reorganizing export/print views. The exact response and code are preserved in the source session link; the captured code for this version is saved at public/artifacts/weekend-plan-checklist-chatgpt-5prompt.html.
steps.response_summary: Attempted cleaner row controls, mobile layout, and print/export improvements.
steps.notes: Verification found a real bug: Generate checklist threw ReferenceError: nextFiveItems is not defined.

steps.prompt_exact: The cleaned-up version has a bug: clicking Generate checklist throws ReferenceError: nextFiveItems is not defined, so the list stays empty. Fix that bug, keep the cleaner row controls, and return the full corrected one-file HTML.
steps.response_exact: ChatGPT returned a corrected full one-file HTML artifact. The exact response and code are preserved in the source session link; the captured final code is saved at public/artifacts/weekend-plan-checklist-chatgpt-6prompt-fixed.html.
steps.response_summary: Fixed missing nextFiveItems and kept cleaner row controls, timing groups, mobile, print, and export behavior.
steps.notes: Verified final fixed artifact with sample generation.
